hlg_d8e5259c55bea167_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Create and configure event details, generate unique invitation codes for guests, and distribute them via email for secure guest access.
hlg_d8e5259c55bea167_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to create and configure event details including name, date, location, and budget via a form interface. llg_002 adds the capability to generate unique invitation codes for each guest and distribute them via email as passwords for guest access. These are distinct, materially different actions involving event setup and guest access provisioning, with no inferred missing operations.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Generate and distribute unique invitation codes to guests

hlg_dc05a6a00e807452_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable event organizers to browse, filter, select, and book event services based on category, price, and availability.
hlg_dc05a6a00e807452_001.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to browse and select event services by filtering on category, price, and availability, and to initiate booking. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal encompasses only this single capability without adding or omitting any detail.

hlg_01a24191de59b423_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable event organizers to browse, select, book, pay for, and monitor real-time budget and availability status of services from registered providers, including on-site and installment payment confirmations.
hlg_01a24191de59b423_001.rationale: llg_001 enables browsing and selecting services based on category, availability, and pricing; llg_002 enables requesting and receiving approval for service appointments; llg_003 enables accepting quotations and triggering budget deduction and payment scheduling; llg_004 enables configuring payment schedule and method; llg_005 enables confirming on-site payment receipt and updating booking status and budget; llg_006 enables confirming installment payments and updating booking status and budget accordingly; llg_007 enables viewing real-time budget allocation and service availability after each transaction. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of service procurement and payment management, including distinct payment types and real-time monitoring.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Browse and select services from registered providers
View real-time budget allocation and service availability

hlg_bba1d36093273738_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable service providers to publish, categorize, and tag their service offerings on the platform for discoverability by event organizers.
hlg_bba1d36093273738_001.rationale: llg_001 enables service providers to publish service offerings by uploading details such as description, pricing, and availability; llg_002 enables them to categorize and tag services to enhance discoverability by event organizers. Together, these capabilities form a complete scope for service publication and metadata management, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.

hlg_5c3d3af4dc08f1eb_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable service providers to manage appointment requests from event organizers, including viewing, approving or declining them, preparing and uploading quotations for approved appointments, and confirming receipt of payments for completed services, with automatic calendar and financial status updates.
hlg_5c3d3af4dc08f1eb_001.rationale: llg_001 enables viewing appointment requests, which is the initial step in managing them. llg_002 adds the capability to approve or decline requests and triggers calendar updates. llg_003 introduces the action of preparing and uploading quotations tied to approved appointments and events. llg_004 adds the capability to confirm payments (single or installment) and update financial status — a distinct lifecycle phase not covered by the prior goals. Together, these form a complete workflow from request to payment confirmation, including associated automation.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Confirm receipt of payment for completed services

hlg_57dbb1d19d575603_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable invited guests to securely access and view event-related content, including blogs and photos, by authenticating via an invitation code.
hlg_57dbb1d19d575603_001.rationale: llg_001 enables secure access to event content through an invitation code, establishing the authentication mechanism. llg_002 extends this by allowing the guest to view specific content types (blogs and photos) after authentication, thus defining the scope of consumable content. Together, they form a complete capability: secure access + content viewing, with no inferred or generalized functionality.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Access event content using invitation code

hlg_d4bd8d89225ca214_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable invited guests to contribute content, media, and feedback to an event blog through posting, uploading, and commenting.
hlg_d4bd8d89225ca214_001.rationale: llg_001 enables content submission (posting blog posts or media), llg_002 enables media uploading (images or videos), and llg_003 enables interaction (commenting on posts). Together, they define a complete scope of guest participation in the event blog: creating content, sharing media, and engaging via comments. No capability is generalized or omitted; each distinct action is preserved.

hlg_e2c0b7b29ea3a654_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable the event organizer to review historical contract data and monitor real-time budget status for financial oversight and decision-making.
hlg_e2c0b7b29ea3a654_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the event organizer to view and manage contract history, including status, cost, and completion details, which supports retrospective analysis of past agreements. llg_002 enables the event organizer to view remaining event budget, which supports real-time financial tracking after accounting for all booked services and expenses. Together, these capabilities cover both historical contract review and current budget monitoring, with no overlap or omission — the reconstructed goal explicitly includes both distinct functional domains without generalizing or omitting either.
